title: Constructing a Lattice-Based SS-NIZK in the Standard Model
summary: Some standard-model PAKEs use SS-NIZKs, while a lattice-based construction in that model remains an open question.

formal_statement.body: Some standard-model PAKEs use a simulation-sound non-interactive zero-knowledge proof (SS-NIZK) approach, but constructing a lattice-based SS-NIZK in the standard model is identified as still an open question.

scope.domain: This concerns lattice-based zero-knowledge proof constructions for standard-model PAKEs.
parameters: lattice-based setting, the required construction setting
standard model, the required security model
